# {{PRODUCT_NAME}}: 30-50 year development, validation and continuity plan

> **Every week, OpenChess turns your own games into the three highest-impact things to train, gives you drills from the positions that caused them, and checks whether the learning transfers to later games.**

**4,825 atomic todos.** Ambition: evolve into the leading chess harness of its generation. Canonical DAG is JSON. Done requires acceptance, exact SHA and evidence. UNVERIFIED is never done.

## Five-outcome spine

1. **First plan from connected games**: correct-account automatic import to cited three-item plan, including failures, time and support.
2. **Trusted diagnosis**: recurring decision errors beat platform, recurrence and centipawn-loss baselines in blind, calibrated tests.
3. **Completed three-item week**: equal-time selected-three plan beats simple alternatives without guilt or excess burden.
4. **Recognized transfer**: later opportunities, not-observed/insufficient states and negative results are measured honestly; no Elo overclaim.
5. **Retained paid cross-device loop at acceptable cost**: complete free local loop plus real EUR8/USD10 retention, E2EE continuity and >=70% p90 margin.

Every task carries `spine_outcome`: O1-O5 or `non-spine`. Five signed gates feed T4794. Code completion cannot waive a failed outcome.

## Layer 2, retained but deferred

Coach champion/referrals, user referrals, titled-player experiences and 2400+ professional mode are preserved as **Layer 2 - post-2027 ecosystem**. All 642 tasks are off the 2027 critical path and explicitly gated on T4794 proving all five outcomes. No Layer 1 task depends on Layer 2.

## 30-50 year durability

Core technology choices use a boring-tech scorecard. The position graph schema and migrations are public; independent readers reconstruct complete exports without the company. AI providers/models, engines, sync transport, storage, billing and UI sit behind replaceable contracts/conformance tests. Releases archive source, binaries, SBOM, docs, schemas, corpus recipes and model cards. Continuity covers user backups, bus factor, succession, domains/signing/trademark, operational recovery and company shutdown/self-host migration. AGPL, corresponding source and data portability let the product survive the company.

Subscriptions fund infrastructure, AI **and sustained development**. Economics value founder time and India-market developer compensation plus statutory/employer cost, equipment, management, audits and contingency. Scenarios at 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000 paid users at EUR8 report affordable capacity and maintenance reserve. If 1,000 x EUR8 cannot fund the chosen team, the plan must explicitly choose price, more users, lower capacity/slower roadmap or other revenue.
